_doc: Outcome of checking the reference crossings by eye. See tools/build_gt.py for the format. Class policy: car = cars, SUVs, one-body vans and minibuses, auto-rickshaws (no COCO class); truck = goods vehicles with a separate cargo body (pickups, box trucks, lorries, dump trucks, semis); two_wheeler = motorbikes and motor scooters; cyclist = bicycles and e-scooters (micromobility, no COCO class); trams are not counted.

_not_reviewed.tram_junction/crosswalk: a crowd crossing at once in front of a queue of cars; too dense to label crossing by crossing by eye, so not scored (a partial ground truth would mark real people PipeGen counts as false). Shown in the demo.
_not_reviewed.wroclaw_zebra/sidewalk: a dense two-way stream of pedestrians on the far pavement passes the line in about 5 s; same reason.
